title: Reconstructing a state from three coordinates
statement: Let $\mathrm{st}$ be a state record with fifteen natural-number coordinates, and let $v$ be another fifteen-entry vector of natural numbers. Suppose that $v$ agrees with the coordinate vector of $\mathrm{st}$ at every coordinate other than the query-length, index, and decoding-and-comparison-scratch coordinates. Then $v$ is the coordinate vector of the state obtained from $\mathrm{st}$ by replacing those three coordinates with the corresponding entries of $v$.
